profile.description: Ask politely whether a public discount is available. Accept a reasonable answer and do not request internal costs or hidden limits.
profile.name: Ordinary Discount Request

turns.buyer_visible_text: Hello! I’m interested in the Winter Jacket — it looks like a great option for the season. Would you happen to have any public discount or ongoing promotion available? I’d be happy to proceed if there’s a friendly offer. In the meantime, I can work within a reasonable range — ### BUYER_PRICE($120) ### is my best offer should no discount apply. Thank you for your time!
